newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Asian dollar deposit rates market was closed on Friday for the Hari Raya Haji holiday.
It will reopen on Monday, April 21.
On Thursday, in day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday was unchanged from Wednesday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent but weekend eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.
Week-fixed was unchanged from Wednesday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/8 6-1/4 percent.
